classes: The sealed bytes depend only on the renderer chain (S1-S3).
Profile v2 cannot be carried on the binding and observation wire until W1-W4 accept it.
Without C1 and C2, v4 is still safe, because an enabled plugin fails closed in A2. It is not live: every Pod is refused, and no v4 A2 claim passes C28.

obligationsOfC1C2.I06 SC05 successor: moves AlwaysPullImages from ALLOWED_ADMISSION to FORBIDDEN_ADMISSION, and its criteria row adds "AlwaysPullImages disabled"
obligationsOfC1C2.W03-0 SC05 successor text: "--enable-admission-plugins and --disable-admission-plugins give exactly the I06 successor's allowed set: NodeRestriction on; webhook admission, MutatingAdmissionPolicy, NamespaceAutoProvision, ImagePolicyWebhook, AlwaysAdmit and AlwaysPullImages off. AlwaysPullImages is named in --disable-admission-plugins (`--disable-admission-plugins=AlwaysPullImages`, one item of that comma-separated list) and never in --enable-admission-plugins. --admission-control-config-file carries the manifest-based admission configuration (OR08)."

rulings.Q-LPK1-R2-1: **Q-LPK1-R2-1, the owner's answer:** "Widen the steps (Recommended)". The owner's three steps carry W1-W3, and W4 is added as one more step. There is no new roadmap item. Profile v1 stays on the wire until every step lands, and nothing installs before then. Rev 2 already follows this.
rulings.MON-LPK1-R2-2: **Q-LPK1-R2-2, monitor ruling under delegation:** (a), recorded now as MON-LPK1-R2-2.
